summary: DAMA P0 (Automatic Validity Filter) feature tested. Backend endpoints for vigencia checking are working correctly - scrapes CMED/ANVISA legislation portal to check if legal resolutions are vigente/caduca/revogada. Frontend modal shows DAMA validation panel with color-coded badges and blocks generation when caduca normas are detected. All 22 backend tests passed, frontend UI working as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: GET /api/dama/vigencia/stats returns total, vigentes, vigentes_com_alteracoes, caducas, revogadas counts
VERIFIED: GET /api/dama/vigencia/check correctly identifies Resolução 07/2022 as 'caduca' with pode_usar=false
VERIFIED: GET /api/dama/vigencia/check correctly identifies Resolução 02/2004 as 'vigente com alterações' with pode_usar=true
VERIFIED: POST /api/dama/vigencia/sync rescrapes CMED legislation portal and returns total count
VERIFIED: POST /api/dama/vigencia/validar-esclarecimento validates key norms and returns bloqueios array
VERIFIED: POST /api/anvisa/esclarecimento without force_generate returns bloqueado=true when caduca normas detected
VERIFIED: POST /api/anvisa/esclarecimento with force_generate=true generates text despite caduca normas
VERIFIED: Frontend DAMA vigencia panel shows stats (35 Vigentes, 8 Com Alterações, 2 Caducas, 41 Revogadas)
VERIFIED: Frontend shows color-coded badges (CADUCA=red, VIGENTE COM ALTERAÇÕES=amber/green, REVOGADA=dark red)
VERIFIED: Generate button shows 'BLOQUEADO - MARQUE A CAIXA PARA PROSSEGUIR' when vigencia has bloqueio
VERIFIED: Checkbox 'Estou ciente e desejo gerar mesmo assim' enables the generate button
